answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The fable multiplier is published, charged in tundra, and marble lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 985 identities would post 2180 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
